purpose: happy path: a birthday gift to a son; the README's example brief and the example novel

traits: afraid of the dark but will not admit it

memories.text: The summer he found a fossil on the beach at Cadaqués and named it Captain Crunch
His dog, a scruffy terrier called Bruno, sleeps at the foot of his bed
He built a cardboard observatory in the garden with his grandfather

mandatory_facts: Leo found a fossil named Captain Crunch
dedication: For Leo, who is braver than he thinks.
free_text: Leo loves maps and always asks what is on the other side of the hill.
